posts.title: Cloud Tip: Least Privilege
posts.body: Give cloud identities only the permissions they actually need. Start narrow, review access regularly, and remove unused permissions.

posts.title: Networking Tip: DNS
posts.body: DNS translates human-readable domain names into IP addresses. When troubleshooting connectivity, checking DNS resolution is often a useful early step.

posts.title: Linux Tip: Logs
posts.body: Logs are one of the fastest ways to understand what a Linux service is doing. Learn to identify the relevant service and inspect its recent log entries before changing configuration.

posts.title: Security Tip: MFA
posts.body: Multi-factor authentication adds another verification factor beyond a password. Enable it on important accounts and keep recovery methods protected.
